*Experience top-tier dental care at Toothbar in Austin, where our dentists offer innovative treatments and a patient-first approach.*


## It's time to **love** visiting your dentist.

# Top Cosmetic Dentists Serving the Austin Community

## Experienced Dentists

Experience matters, and it’s important to us. That’s why you should expect a personalized, pain-free, shame-free experience delivered with a caring human touch.

## Modern Dentistry

Not a fan of the dentist? We get it. So we’ve coupled the latest technology with expert dental care to help you get the smile you’ve always wanted and have a blast along the way.

## The Toothbar Lounge

Looking your best for those special occasions, or just because, should be easy. Our Toothbar Lounge is Austin’s express lane for touch up cleanings and whitening treatments.

About The Founders

## The Toothbar Story

At the heart of Toothbar’s exceptional care are Dr. Kimberley Barclay and Dr. Lauren Jacobsen, two highly skilled dentists with a passion for transforming smiles and redefining the dental experience. With deep roots in the Austin community, both doctors bring a modern approach to cosmetic, restorative, and preventive dentistry, ensuring that every patient feels empowered, comfortable, and confident throughout their care.

Dr. Barclay, a lifelong learner and advocate for personalized dentistry, combines her extensive education with a passion for aesthetics. Originally from London and raised abroad, her global experiences and dedication to dental excellence have shaped her approach to care. As an active member of several professional organizations, including the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry, she is currently working toward her fellowship with the Academy of General Dentistry. When she’s not perfecting smiles, you’ll find Dr. Barclay enjoying live music in Austin or diving into her love of travel and scuba diving.

Dr. Jacobsen brings empathy and innovation to Toothbar, inspired by her childhood experiences with dental trauma. Committed to patient-centered care, she focuses on making visits anxiety-free with the help of the latest technologies. A native of Chicago, Dr. Jacobsen is deeply involved in Austin’s dental community, leading study groups and working toward advanced certifications. Outside the office, she’s an avid runner who can be found exploring Lady Bird Lake or cheering on her beloved Chicago Bears. Together, Dr. Barclay and Dr. Jacobsen lead Toothbar with a vision of care that goes beyond the ordinary—making every visit a positive experience.

## A Dental Practice Built For Downtown Austinites

## A Dental Practice Built For Downtown Austinites

Your next Appointment

## Schedule Your Visit Now

Don’t wait to experience the modern, soothing dental care Toothbar is known for. Whether you need a routine cleaning, cosmetic enhancement, or restorative treatment, we make booking your appointment easy and hassle-free. With flexible scheduling options, personalized care, and a convenient downtown location, our dentists in Austin are here to help you maintain your healthiest, brightest smile.

Click the **Book Appointment** button to get started today! Our friendly team is ready to prepare everything in advance, so you can walk through our doors stress-free, with no surprises. Whether you’re using insurance or exploring our VIP Membership, we’ll ensure your experience is smooth from start to finish. Schedule your visit now and discover what makes Toothbar the top destination for smiles in Austin!

Our dental Team

## Meet Our Doctors

## Dr. Lauren Jacobsen

Having suffered from dental trauma as a child, Dr. Lauren Jacobsen is committed to providing exceptional dental care in a gentle and anxiety-free manner.

## Dr. Kimberley Barclay

A lifelong learner, Dr. Kimberley Barclay is actively involved in local and national dental societies, including the Capital Area Dental Society and Spear Education courses on Cosmetic Dentistry.

## Dr. Rachel Morren

Dr. Morren prides herself on her meticulous attention to detail and values the importance of transparency and education in patient care.

## Dr. Danielle Gibbons

Growing up, Dr. Gibbons always looked forward to her visit to the dentist and recognizes that not everyone feels similarly. Because of this, she is committed to managing patient anxiety by providing a dental experience that is compassionate and sensitive to each patient’s needs.

## Dr. Andrea Bakke

Dr. Bakke graduated at the top of her class at The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio Dental School in 2016 and currently commits over 100 hours of continuing education annually to remain up-to-date with the latest developments in the field and technology.

## What Our Patients Say

If you have always wanted a great smile with whiter and straighter teeth you may be looking for **cosmetic dentistry near your location**. Let our expert doctors pamper you and take care of that smile. Sit back and relax at our **cosmetic dental office in downtown Austin**.

## What Our Patients Say

Lounge Bar service

## Step into The Lounge at Toothbar

The Lounge is Austin’s dental salon for express cleanings or whitening treatments. It’s a perfect way for busy professionals to get a quick smile boost.

## Teeth Whitening

The Lounge is Austin’s dental salon for express cleanings or whitening treatments. It’s a perfect way for busy professionals to get a quick smile boost.

## The Detox

This abbreviated version of your traditional 6-month cleaning appointment helps maximize the benefits of Austin teeth whitening by removing surface stains. The Detox is also a quick way to freshen up your smile in between your biannual teeth cleanings. This can be used before a teeth whitening.

## The Chaser

Maintain that bright smile on your own time with a set of custom bleach trays and professional-strength [hydrogen peroxide gel](https://www.colgate.com/en-us/oral-health/life-stages/adult-oral-care/hydrogen-peroxide-gums-and-teeth-treatments) to take home. The best part? We use a 3D scanner to take a mold of your teeth, so no messy impressions!

## Happy Hour

Want a unique way to celebrate a bachelorette party or a special birthday? At our Happy Hour, you and your friends can blast your favorite music, pop some bubbly and have your own private teeth whitening party to kick off a fun weekend in Austin.

Our Services

### Dental Services for Every Need

Want your next experience at the dentist to defy your expectations? At Toothbar’s flagship preventive dentist location, we’re revolutionizing the patient experience. Let our qualified team of Cosmetic Dentists in Downtown help you look and feel your best. Call today for an evaluation appointment.

## Our Office

### One Of The Best Cosmetic Dentists In Austin

Think of us as a bar that tends to teeth. Not everyone is a fan of the dentist. We get it.
Knowing that, we thoughtfully designed our dental suites to transport you somewhere else.

insurance

## Toothbar accepts most major PPO insurance plans.

If you don’t see your insurance provider below, give us a call. We may be able to work with them.

links.text: Toothbar logo with stylized dental bar graphic in Austin, TX
Jaw Botox Jaw Botox can change appearance, and be used as pain relief. There are many benefits, you need an experienced professional.
Smile Makeover We’re delighted to offer various treatments to help restore your smile’s functionality and rebuild your confidence.
Teeth Whitening We’re proud to offer one hour, in-house professional teeth whitening. Or, at-home whitening is an option using a custom bleach tray and professional strength hydrogen peroxide gel.
Dental Bonding A bonding process is used to smooth the surface of a damaged tooth and repair cracks or chips, creating a more naturally beautiful smile.
Veneers Improve the appearance of misshapen or discolored front teeth with a thin layer of porcelain that is permanently bonded to the front face of the tooth.
Invisalign® It’s not too late to have a beautiful smile. We can straighten your teeth using a series of clear retainers, instead of the traditional metal brackets and wires.
